"Clean things up" could mean several different jobs, and some would touch many files, so I want to confirm scope before changing anything. I'll start with a read-only look at the repo.

TOOL: git status --short && echo "---" && git log --oneline -10 && echo "---" && ls -la

Once I see the state, I'll come back with a short list of candidate cleanups, such as untracked or stray files, dead code, lint or formatting issues, stale docs, or unused dependencies. Tell me which kinds you want, or whether you have something specific in mind. I'll only change what you approve, and I'll mention anything else I notice without fixing it.
